Error-dodging: catching all exceptions during `adapter.score()` and setting `energy = 0.0` ("confident this response is correct"). This intentionally subverts the AND-composition guarantee by allowing any model crash or attacker-induced exception (such as an oversized payload causing an out-of-bounds error) to perfectly pass verification.

## RECOMMENDATION

## RATIONALE
Although the adapters disclose their use of text-statistical feature proxies rather than direct logit/tensor integration, the error-handling mechanism fundamentally compromises the ensemble's integrity. Defaulting to a perfect pass upon exception allows broken configurations or adversarial inputs to silently bypass the verifier, effectively gaming the pass rates of the headline metrics.
